title: Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew originating from Tunisia, slow-cooked with aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Aromatic spice mix (e.g., ras el hanout)
Tunisian chili peppers (or substitute with red pepper flakes)

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Brown lamb pieces in batches until browned, then set aside.
Soften onion and garlic, then add spice mix and cook 1 minute.
Add lamb back in, cover with lid, and transfer to the oven (preheated to 300°F/150°C).
Braise for 2 hours or until lamb is tender.
Stir in breadcrumbs and chili peppers; return to heat to crisp.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with crispy breadcrumbs and additional chili peppers if desired.
